crop.notes: Only the headline and first paragraph; the item continues at the top of the next column (death at the City Hospital and Allen's claim he thought Coupry would shoot him).

ocr.notes: Matches the cropped part ('championship' in print for 'champion'); transcript stops where the crop does.

summary.suggested: The Sedalia Democrat reported that Tom Allen, once heavyweight champion, was under arrest at the Four Courts in St. Louis, charged with murder after a man he shot in his saloon died.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'Sedalia Democrat: Friday, March 3, 1899', page 11, so the date is 1899-03-03 (not 03-02). Printed name is Sedalia Democrat; possibly its weekly edition, check before changing.

facts.fact: Allen was held under arrest at the Four Courts, St. Louis, charged with murder

notes: Reprint of the wire item in 182 (Feb. 27 dateline). The victim's name is misprinted 'Coupry' (Timothy Confoy). Recrop to include the continuation at the top of the fourth column.
